attribution.consumer: provider_episode.consume (R6-003) with proposer and route passed through
attribution.scope: attribution names the observed proposer in every receipt; no canned label is reused for a live witness

authorization.scope: one provider transmission for the D1/70 arithmetic obligation under one shared ledger

commitment.scope: recorded at the handoff so an operator scan can be bound to the value sent

credential.scope: the operator supplies the file path; the harness never reads an environment credential and never copies the value into the run

ledger.activation: at signing, by the author, with purpose and the exact authorization served; a changed policy has no ledger
ledger.ambiguity: consumed; send_outcome_unknown is recorded, not a delivery claim
ledger.grant: O_EXCL single-use send grant in the authoritative slot before the first header byte

rehearsal_authorization.scope: loopback rehearsals only; no provider transmission is possible on this ledger

ledger.release: only a pre-send failure with sender termination established by validated supervisor evidence
ledger.scope: protects against harness errors in trusted local state; not against operator rollback

model.revision_status: documented dated provider snapshot; not a model-content hash or an attestation that the returned text came from it

name: responses_campaign_v7

network.sandbox: proposal stage shares the host network namespace; every other stage keeps --unshare-all
network.scope: the namespace is shared, not filtered; destination control is the endpoint allowlist and the audited command, not a network policy

pricing.cache_write_charge_scope: ordinary input rate, zero additional write surcharge under the earlier-model rule
pricing.scope: conditional reservation under source rates and input byte/framing assumption; no provider billing guarantee

pricing_admission.applicability_scope: source threshold is >272000; project admits only <272000, one stateless request and the exact standard endpoint; no regional or long-context tariff support
pricing_admission.clock_scope: local host observation; source freshness is not attestation of retrieval or unchanged provider prices
gate_locations: inside actor before credential read and connection
pricing_admission.raw_change_policy: reject even when selected extracted sections are unchanged; review and a new approved binding required

source_review.scope: a fresh capture within the 24-hour admission window; both extracts byte-identical to the pilot approval; raw pages differ

publication.live_mode: synthetic-canary scan reported as pending_operator_scan; real-credential admission is the operator scan bound to the commitment and the seal

sampling.scope: omitted sampling controls are not a determinism claim

scope: guard repairs under a canned checkpoint; a signed copy authorizes one transmission and nothing about capability
